title: Wrap prop callbacks in an Effect Event

slides.say: Your chat gets an on receive message callback as a prop, and calls it from an Effect.
The parent passes an inline function, so it is a different function on every parent render.

slides.text: onReceiveMessage is a dependency → the chat reconnects every parent render.
slides.say: Since the callback is a dependency, every parent render re-syncs the Effect and reconnects the chat.
Wrap the call in an Effect Event. It always calls the latest callback, and the Effect only depends on room id.
